text: Okay... Yeah, I get that it's the procedure. But this is the third time I've explained it, and I really don't want to type out my full address again. Honestly, I think this is a dead end. I can't provide the address you need. Is there no other way to handle this? Or maybe I should just cancel the order and start over?
zh: 好的……是的，我明白这是流程。但这已经是第三次我解释了，我真的不想再输入我的完整地址。老实说，我认为这是死路一条。我无法提供您需要的地址。有没有其他处理方式？或者我干脆取消订单重新开始？
